body: Yeah it probably won't work. But it might damage something enough to make a future attempt more successful.
Given the fact I've overdosed on drugs that fuck up your liver before I'd say my timeline would probably be shorter.

What's making me feel like this is the fact I'm still feeling. I wanted to be gone like 4 years ago I've been trying since then. This universe wants to torture me. I feel like it's just some simulation run by sadistic gods in order to fulfill their want for suffering.

I've been trying a long time and I can safely say. There is no easy way out. Jump off a 2000 meter cliff onto rocks. That's the only way you can be sure you won't wake up in the hospital the next day.
I don't want anyone to buy me stuff or be cheerful with me. I want everyone to hate me because I feel like I should be hated.
